subject: 英文

essays.text: 請將下列英文翻譯為中文：（30 分）Legal education plays a crucial role in our democratic society based on therule of law. A full and rich legal education ensures the quality of legalprofessionals. In Taiwan, since the beginning of this century, we have seensignificant improvements in law teaching and learning, as well as the nationalexaminations for different legal professionals. Nevertheless, the world ischanging fast and technology is growing exponentially, it is important that lawschools and teachers must adapt to the new environment. The use of advancedtechnology, such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), to assist teaching isunavoidable. Law teachers should, through on-the-job training, understand theinner workings of AI in order to maximize its benefits.
請將以下中文翻譯為英文：（30 分）所謂定型化契約，係指以一方當事人預先擬定之條款為内容而訂立之契約。其特色在於，他方必須接受該條款，而無商量餘地。根據消費者保護法第 11 條至第 17 條之 1、金融消費者保護法第 7 條及民法第 247 條之 1，定型化契約應符合公平合理、平等互惠及誠實信用，始為有效。
英文作文：（40 分）What are the advantages and disadvantages of having a lease notarized?Please elucidate.
